description: Elections Commission - A. A. A. Kumara of the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna Party - H. J. Sri Kantha of the Nattandiya Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the vacation of office by members of a local authority (Pradeshiya Sabha) due to ceasing membership in a political party, which is a notice issued under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. This directly relates to electoral processes and the status of elected officials, falling under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral matters including declarations about candidate/member status.
